business_problem: With domestic e-book growth slowing, Japan’s manga industry faces a pivotal shift toward global expansion. The success depends on transforming manga for a global audience, which requires sophisticated localization, including full-color adaptation tailored to local cultural expectations and reformatting into vertically scrollable layouts optimized for smartphones. The industry’s key challenge lies in enhancing technical capabilities while simultaneously optimizing costs, enabling faster, more affordable product releases and broader service delivery to an ever-growing global audience.
